Messages.Author: Miller Delmardigan
Messages.Body:
Official card text of the Bomb:

Cardtype: Equipment
Cost: 1 pool
Weapon.
5R damage as a strike. If the {bomb is used in combat, the bearer} takes
5 damage as well. The minion with this weapon may burn a location as a
(D) action. Burn the Bomb after use.

That card text is, by the way, different from card text in ELDB.

Do the Bomb burn if the action to burn a location provided by Bomb's
card text is blocked?
I searched through google without getting any clear answer about that.

Thanks

Messages.Body:
> Do the Bomb burn if the action to burn a location provided by Bomb's
> card text is blocked?
> I searched through google without getting any clear answer about that.

I'd say the burning the Bomb is the cost of the action. As with all
actions, the cost doesn't need to be payed if the action is blocked.

That's how I've been playing Bomb all along. I might be wrong, of
course.
